content:
Apple's newly appointed CEO has officially opened an account on social platform X, with the username @johnternus. His personal bio simply reads "CEO", and his first post consists of just one word: "hello"。

Today marks Ternus's first day as CEO, while outgoing Tim Cook will transition to the role of Executive Chairman.

Overall, Apple's relationship with social media has always been intriguing. The company itself has an @apple account, but aside from running sponsored advertisements, it has not posted any other content. However, senior executives such as former CEO Tim Cook and Senior Vice President of Marketing Greg Jozwiak all maintain public personal accounts.

It is still unclear what content Ternus will post on X, but his operation is expected to be similar to the Cook era, including announcing new product news and occasionally issuing statements on various company initiatives.

Next Wednesday, Apple is expected to hold its major fall product launch event, where it will unveil new iPhones and Apple Watch models. Ternus's account is sure to be very active at that time.

Ternus previously served as Senior Vice President of Hardware Engineering for five years, accumulating a quarter-century of service at Apple. His appointment this time can be described as a meteoric rise to the CEO position. He is widely regarded externally as a product-focused helmsman, whereas his predecessor Cook was more known for operational management.
